document.abstract: The meeting on 9 December took the form of a holiday party at the Thunder Grill Washington's Union (railroad) Station, jointly hosted by the SMPTE Washington, D.C., Section and the Washington, D.C., chapter of the Society of Broadcast Engineers. This marked the second such collaborative holiday affair between the two groups.
